decisions.choice: Category theory, Algebraic structures, Differential geometry

Differential geometry is needed to handle the complex analytic aspects of modular forms and their geometric interpretation on modular curves.

The universality claim requires constructing a suitable categorical framework where all these connections can be formalized as functors.
